name: sdd
description: Reusable Spec-Driven Development bootstrap, discovery, review, architecture, and decision-record workflows for software engineering.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare, specify, review, and design software changes.
interface.longDescription: Reusable Spec-Driven Development workflows for repository preparation, requirements discovery, specification authoring, independent review, traceable architecture design, and architectural decision records.
defaultPrompt: Use $project-bootstrap to prepare this repository for the SDD workflow.
Use $spec-author to prepare an implementation-ready specification.
Use $spec-reviewer to assess whether this specification is implementation-ready.
Use $architecture-designer to design a traceable architecture from this specification.
Use $adr-author to clarify an architectural decision and record it with the appropriate status.
